purpose: 沿第1实际源提供的中文原href作第2/最后GET，核原时钟与预告证据，不猜URL
program:
from pathlib import Path
import requests,json,hashlib,datetime
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
base=Path.cwd();out=base/'reports/research/510300_policy_press_preview_information_clock_v1'
url='http://www.scio.gov.cn/live/2024/34875/tw/'
catalog=out/'raw/scio_actual_event_topic.html'
assert url in catalog.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
selected={'url':url,'source':'第1实际专题的Read in Chinese原href，不猜URL；固定9/24中文现场页，核预告或实际发布时间证据','catalog_raw_sha256':hashlib.sha256(catalog.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'GET_number':2,'budget_GETs':2,'selected_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat(),'allow_redirects':False,'no_auth':True,'no_retry':True}
(out/'实际中文现场href_请求前选择.json').write_text(json.dumps(selected,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
session=requests.Session();session.trust_env=False;session.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0','Accept':'text/html,application/xhtml+xml'})
receipt=dict(selected)
try:
    response=session.get(url,timeout=(10,25),allow_redirects=False)
    body=response.content;(out/'raw').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    path=out/'raw/scio_actual_chinese_live.html';path.write_bytes(body)
    receipt.update(http_status=response.status_code,bytes=len(body),sha256=hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),location=response.headers.get('Location'),raw_path='raw/scio_actual_chinese_live.html')
    if response.status_code==200:
        try:html=body.decode('utf-8')
        except UnicodeDecodeError:html=body.decode('gb18030')
        soup=BeautifulSoup(html,'html.parser')
        for x in soup(['script','style']):x.decompose()
        (out/'中文现场实际正文.txt').write_text(soup.get_text('\n',strip=True),encoding='utf-8')
        receipt['actual_anchors']=[{'title':a.get_text(' ',strip=True),'href':a['href']} for a in soup.find_all('a',href=True) if a.get_text(' ',strip=True)]
except Exception as e:receipt.update(http_status='NOT_RECEIVED',error_type=type(e).__name__,error=str(e))
finally:session.close()
receipt['finished_at']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
(out/'中文现场GET_实际收件.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
